content: Design a geometric model consisting of two square plates, each with an edge length of 140mm and a thickness of 10mm. Position these plates so that they intersect at a 90-degree angle, creating an L-shape configuration. On one of these plates, incorporate a square cutout measuring 45x45mm. | Now i want you to execute the prepared function calls one after the other. If you need to do some calculations or geometrical algebra, use the CreateCode Function first. Execute the first prepared function call. Submit all required variables at once

function_call.arguments: "{\"PythonCode\":\"# Calculate the positions and dimensions for the two plates\\n# Plate 1: Horizontal plate (along x-y plane)\\nplate1_x_size = 140\\nplate1_y_size = 140\\nplate1_z_size = 10\\nplate1_x = 0\\nplate1_y = 0\\nplate1_z = 0\\n\\n# Plate 2: Vertical plate (along y-z plane)\\nplate2_x_size = 10\\nplate2_y_size = 140\\nplate2_z_size = 140\\nplate2_x = 0\\nplate2_y = 0\\nplate2_z = 0\\n\\n# Square cutout on Plate 1 (horizontal plate)\\ncutout_x_size = 45\\ncutout_y_size = 45\\ncutout_z_size = 10\\ncutout_x = (plate1_x_size - cutout_x_size) / 2  # Centered along x\\ncutout_y = (plate1_y_size - cutout_y_size) / 2  # Centered along y\\ncutout_z = 0\\n\\n# Return all calculated values\\n(plate1_x_size, plate1_y_size, plate1_z_size, plate1_x, plate1_y, plate1_z,\\n plate2_x_size, plate2_y_size, plate2_z_size, plate2_x, plate2_y, plate2_z,\\n cutout_x_size, cutout_y_size, cutout_z_size, cutout_x, cutout_y, cutout_z)\"}"
